title: Scholarships | Engineering
description: SRMIST extends several scholarships, fee waiver schemes, teaching and research assistance to meritorious and deserving students.
heading: CET - Scholarships
notes: Number of Scholarships might slightly vary based on the number of test takers in each phase.
All scholarships are valid only on academic tuition fee except Founder’s Scholarship. Transport / Hostel / other charges are payable.
Not applicable for industry partnered programs (Annexure – A).
Seats under each category are limited and are awarded on a first opt basis.
